annotations.title: Record Your Answer to an Offer

description: Records the person's choice on one of their saved offers: accept, smaller, different or not_now. accept creates the assignment from exactly that draft, atomically; the other three assign nothing. A recorded choice is never rewritten.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.
